study: UK Parliament 2024–2026 petitions, administrative threshold event histories
fixed_selection: First 12 links with IDs 17–28 on official archived closed petitions page sorted by signature_count descending as crawled 2026-08, with no random inclusion. Freeze before opening individual JSON; top sample is LEFT-TRUNCATED BY OUTCOME, cannot estimate probabilities for all petitions or threshold causal effects.
selection_preexposure: Titles and counts of top 12 CLOSED petitions already viewed via official list; timelines and discussion outcomes of all except first one NOT yet read, first id 700143 response+debate timeline preexposed in official API feasibility.
R1: Unit petition, not signature=unique eligible individual; signatures may be repeated across petitions. Event timestamps are not first-public dataset times.
R2: Appropriate institutional baseline: legal response threshold 10,000 and consideration-for-debate 100,000; not guaranteed instant debate nor threshold is measure of quality.
R3: Top-signed selection, no random sampling, first petition already source-exposed; exploratory all 5 and report uncertainty, no confirmatory p values.
R4: Compare creation→opening vs threshold→response and debate; test censoring and scheduled-vs-completed statuses; do not transform legal guarantee into causal identification.
R5: Download original JSON if possible, HTML official index as fallback with explicit provenance. Never spend cycles on inaccessible binary retries.
I: No political endorsement/stance, scores or individual petition signatory records
A: Do official petition API scheduled/completed debate dates match a second institutional record (Hansard) on a fixed set of completed debates selected mechanically from the 12 petitions?

B.H1: Every completed debate among first five source-completed records has a working Hansard transcript on same date
B.Halt: Source could point to relevant other type of debate (not standalone petition debate)

C: Within fixed first 12 list, take first up to 5 items ordered by original list position with non-null debate.debated_on AND transcript_url; inspect each Hansard transcript landing URL + date (not content/party rating), report verified 0..5 and missing. No source-independent finding if only link is copied, not opened.
F: API Hansard transcript is same institutional umbrella UK Parliament but independent record service; link existence not equivalent to transcript body validation
G: Administrative audit not sociological mechanism replication
J: If transcript pages blocked, label unverified; keep no invented authenticity.
